name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: The question at the center of this role, whether you're giving the customer a clear reason to care, is the one I ask before I write any message. A photo album is a record of something that mattered to someone. Lifecycle marketing for that product should feel like it remembers what they made, and I'd like to build that here in Denver.

I build lifecycle systems end to end. At Solenzo I designed a 20+ workflow system covering welcome, post-purchase onboarding, review requests, long-term nurture, and reactivation of lapsed customers, segmented on behavior and lifecycle stage. I write the copy, build custom tracking events in GA4 and Google Tag Manager, and read the results myself. At Wix I helped established retailers launch online stores, across an e-commerce segment that saw a 30% traffic lift and 25% conversion improvement, and I led onboarding teams of up to 30.
Klaviyo would be new to me; my email work has been in Mailchimp, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, and the flow logic carries over. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
